stories.headline: Trumbull High ranks 23rd among Connecticut public high schools in Niche 2027 list
stories.summary: Niche’s 2027 Best Schools rankings put Trumbull High School 23rd among Connecticut’s top 100 public high schools, drawing on federal and state data, school stats, and more than 3 million reviews nationwide. The firm also separated public and private lists for arts, diversity, college prep, and teachers this year. Connecticut private schools Choate Rosemary Hall and The Hotchkiss School landed No. 5 and No. 9 on Niche’s national private high school list.

stories.headline: LEGO Dragon Ball leak: 1,764-piece Shenron & Goku Icons set eyed for Nov. 1 at ~$180
stories.summary: Leaked images shared Monday by Brick Tap appear to show LEGO Icons 11390 Shenron and Goku — Dragon Ball’s first official set — with the wish-granting dragon coiled above all seven Dragon Balls and young Goku on the Flying Nimbus. Reports peg a November 1 shelf date, about 1,764 pieces, and roughly $180, revising earlier $199.99 / 1,760-piece tip sheets. Fans still treat the specs as provisional until LEGO unveils; separate chatter still points to a broader Dragon Ball Z theme in 2027.

stories.headline: Trump unveils $15B Mesabi Metallics Iowa steel mill — billed as America’s largest
stories.summary: President Trump on Monday announced a roughly $15 billion Mesabi Metallics integrated steel plant in Iowa that the White House calls the largest ever built in the United States, with about 1,750 permanent jobs and 5,000–6,000 construction jobs in the first phase. The mill is slated to make 7.5 million tons a year initially and up to 10 million using iron ore from Mesabi’s Minnesota mine — first steel not expected until 2030. Officials cast it as a tariff-backed, defense-grade domestic supply chain win ahead of the Nov. 3 midterms.

stories.headline: Dubas: Penguins are mid-pack — Rust week-to-week, Lizotte could dress Wednesday
stories.summary: After locking the 22-man opener roster, GM Kyle Dubas said Pittsburgh still sits in the Metro’s middle of the pack and must close the gap on Cup-champion Carolina with younger help around Crosby, Malkin, and Letang. Injury notes: Bryan Rust is week-to-week (upper body), Blake Lizotte’s IR is retroactive to Sept. 19 so he could be available for Wednesday at the Flyers, and Ryan Graves’ dual-knee issues leave him indefinite. Dubas also said Crosby extension talks are open-ended and that Andrei Kuzmenko remains non-roster after his father’s funeral.

stories.headline: Jets takeaways: Glenn praises fourth-quarter fight; Demario Davis leads No. 2 defense
stories.summary: After Sunday’s 31–24 road loss in Detroit left the Jets 1–2, coach Aaron Glenn said he won’t take moral victories but liked the late fight — two fourth-quarter TD drives and a fourth-down stop before Geno Smith and Garrett Wilson briefly tied it at 24. Wilson finished with 7 catches for 107 yards and a score; Demario Davis led the defense with 10 tackles and a sack as New York ranks No. 2 in total defense. Rookie CB D’Angelo Ponds made his NFL debut (4 snaps) after a calf rehab, with Chicago next on the road in Week 4.

stories.headline: Tesla pushes Roadster hover demo from Oct. 1 to Oct. 15 over Texas weather
stories.summary: Tesla officially moved its next-gen Roadster outdoor demo from October 1 to October 15, citing severe central Texas weather for an event that can only be held outdoors at SpaceX’s McGregor rocket test site. The plan still centers on a remotely operated cold-gas thruster “hover” with spectators kept hundreds of yards back. Forecasts show heavy rain and thunderstorms Thursday then clearing by the weekend; Electrek notes the two-week slip continues a long delay chain, with production still guided for 2027 or 2028.

stories.headline: Honor Magic 9 Pro Max debuts in China with Arri cinema tools and 8,800mAh battery
stories.summary: Honor’s Magic 9 Pro Max launched in China Monday with an Arri-inspired three-lens turret camera island, Arri LogC3 recording, 14 Arri Look LUTs, and a 200MP main plus 200MP 3.5x telephoto. A huge 8,800mAh silicon-rich battery sits behind Snapdragon 8 Elite Extreme Gen 6 silicon, and the phone supports Honor’s G200/G500 teleconverters plus a SmallRig video kit. An international launch is confirmed but undated.

stories.headline: watchOS 27.0.1 expands beyond Series 12 and Ultra 4 to all eligible Apple Watches
stories.summary: Apple on Monday released watchOS 27.0.1 for every eligible Apple Watch — Series 9 and later, Ultra 2 and later, and SE 3 — after last week’s build targeted only Series 12 and Ultra 4 for unexpected restart bugs. Release notes only say the update “provides bug fixes,” with no listed security patches, so it is unclear what older models gain. Owners still hope it also steadies indoor/outdoor run distance tracking that has been erratic since watchOS 27 shipped September 14.

stories.headline: Acadia fall 2026: peak color forecast Oct. 12–15 lands as free bus and ships exit
stories.summary: A Sept. 28 foliage model puts Acadia peak color around October 13 (aim Oct. 12–15), the same stretch when the Island Explorer free bus ends (operator date Oct. 12), Seawall and Schoodic Woods close, and Bar Harbor’s last two big cruise ships call. Cadillac Mountain still needs a $6 vehicle reservation through Oct. 25; Blackwoods camps through Oct. 18 and Jordan Pond House through Oct. 26. Part of Beech Mountain Loop Trail has been closed for repairs since Sept. 21, with three alternate summit routes still open.

stories.headline: Canon EOS R6 V firmware 1.1.0 unlocks external flash, BR-E2 remote, and movie grids
stories.summary: Canon’s EOS R6 V firmware 1.1.0 finally delivers external-flash firing with E-TTL II controls, Wireless Remote Controller BR-E2 support, and a composition grid that stays visible while recording — plus EDSDK/CCAPI hooks and fixes for interval timer, smartphone USB, and Slow & Fast Motion Digital IS metadata. Flash still syncs only at 1/60 second on the electronic shutter, so the update helps controlled hybrid stills more than sunlit action. Owners should verify the exact regional package and retest flash, remote, and cards before paid work.
